detail.longDescription: Today Zabbix triggered alerts about my home assistant deployment (replicaset mismatch/pod crashlooping). - Turned out renovate-bot updated image version and pushed to main, then ArgoCD did auto-sync and issue started. - Home assistant can't run 2 instances of itself and old pod was still running. So deployment was stuck. (I removed old pod manually and problem was solved) But I need to prevent it from happening again, so: - I'll change deployment strategy to Recreate for HA. - I'll setup manual approve for renovate-bot before it'll push to main https:// codefloe.com/rpi-homelab/kuber netes-manifests/issues/12 P.S. - I've setup renovate for my homelab (it works great 👍) - I'm trying to do one issue per day (but it mostly isn't worth mentioning here) - I'm learning for CKS currently (so I'll probably setup sth on my homelab specifically to learn for exam, like Falco 💀) # HomeLab # Kubernetes # Zabbix # SelfHost
